title: Move Color+Theme.swift to top-level Extensions folder
description: Theme colors are scoped to OnboardingFlow/Extensions/ but the tokens are used app-wide. They should be moved to a more central Extensions/ folder.

title: Extract companionDatabase to a static resource file
description: CompanionPlantingService contains a large companionDatabase dictionary embedded as Swift source. This static data should be moved to a JSON or plist resource file.

title: Move ValidatedTextField from Services to Components
description: ValidatedTextField is currently defined in GrowWiseServices/ValidationService.swift. This is a major layer violation; UI components must reside in GrowWiseFeature/Components.

title: Consolidate scattered model enum extensions
description: PlantType has two separate extensions in two different files - iconName in SkillAssessmentView and color in PlantDatabaseView. These should be consolidated into a shared location.

title: Refactor DataService to extract domain-specific repositories
description: DataService is a God object (1,317 lines). Extract domain-specific repos like PlantRepository, ReminderRepository, and JournalRepository. The 8-init-path initialization is a reliability risk.
close_reason: Extracted domain repositories from DataService God-object and migrated view call sites
